name: text-slant-swing
title: Slant Axis Swing
description: Từng ký tự nghiêng dần sang phải rồi đứng thẳng lại, lệch nhau 80 ms, như hàng chữ đung đưa trong gió.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Split chars; slnt 0 → −10 → 0 (RFlex range −10..0), 2 s per swing sine.inOut, loop, char i delayed 80 ms; pivot on the baseline. Demo: slnt = −10 × (1 − cos(2π(t − 0.08 i)/2))/2 drawn as a skew about the baseline; loop 2 s. Fallback without a slnt axis: skewX(slnt deg), origin 50 % 100 %. Params: slnt: độ nghiêng (0 → −10) · period: mỗi lượt (2 s) · stagger (0.08 s). Needs a slnt axis (the glyphs lean about the baseline); without one, a skewX(slnt deg) about 50 % 100 % gives the same look.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ nghiêng đung đưa theo gió
